exact_immutable_source_binding.scope: Source binding of earlier fresh actual JUnit/Gradle model results; no test rerun or changed-input substitution

actual_root_expected_rejection.scope: Actual immutable root configuration rejects one deliberately tainted version before task execution; expected Gradle1 is a passing rejection test, not a build pass. No shell, manifest stamping, staging, credentials or publication.

criteria.evidence: Actual owning Kotlin/JUnit method accepts eight stable/snapshot/preview examples without normalization. Root uses the same compiled policy and actual configuration retains default0.1.0-SNAPSHOT for145 publications.

criteria.requirement: Reject command substitution, quotes, newlines, sed delimiters, branch path traversal and empty versions
criteria.evidence: Actual owning Kotlin/JUnit tables reject24 unsafe values and11 malformed forms, plus a diagnostic sentinel; an immutable actual root configuration rejects command-substitution input with expected Gradle1 before any root task. Quotes/newlines/sed/path traversal/empty values are covered, diagnostics omit tainted bytes.

criteria.requirement: Exercise stamp/update helpers against temporary manifests without any credentials or remote publication
criteria.evidence: Old inherited shell stamp/update helpers are archived inert metadata, not active/reachable production helpers. Both active workflows are manual/read-only and contain no shell stamp/update or release template. No archived script was executed, no synthetic manifest rewrite was falsely certified; any future helper needs its own implementation and acceptance tests before the independent release gate.
